title: The Sash Incident
summary: The weather desk's forecast accuracy has collapsed for a single reason: Pemmy's sash — the official caprine-instrument sash, Guild-stamped, tasselled — has gone missing somewhere on her morning rounds. Retrace the goat. Recover the sash. Do not, under any circumstances, write a report.

objectives.label: Search the water-tower shade for sash parts — tassel count is recorded evidence
Sweep the moorage mast foot — she rubs her horns on the guy-lines
Check the dune overlook, where the goat does her serious staring
Return the reassembled sash to the weather desk box

offer.text: Courier. The caprine division has suffered what my report calls an Instrument Presentation Event and what the division calls Tuesday. Pemmy's sash is gone. The sash is the instrument — a sashless goat is, Guild-wise, just a goat with opinions.

Her rounds: water tower at dawn, moorage lines by mid-morning, the overlook for the long staring. She molts pageantry everywhere she goes. Gather the tassels, the stamp-clasp, and whatever has absorbed the most dignity. Reassembly is optional but encouraged.
You're paying guild rates for me to follow a goat around town collecting sash pieces.

The Guild pays for outcomes, Varga, not narrative dignity. Besides — her stare-frequency readings drop eleven percent without the sash. Whether the sash is causal is under review. It has been under review for three years.

accept.text: Accepted and logged as a *textile-sensitive recovery*. She favours shade she can supervise from. If you find the stamp-clasp near anything edible, assume the edible ate it on purpose.

Ketch here. You're goat-wrangling for the desk now? Good. That goat has forecast more storms than every gauge I own. Comb the town slow, kid — tassels snag on the line shadows, and Pemmy hides the good parts where the looking is embarrassing.
*Maaaa.* (Desk note attached to the job: the instrument has been informed. The instrument declined comment.)

complete.text: Sash received: eight tassels of nine, one clasp, a soupçon of someone's lunch. Restored to the instrument —

Update. The instrument has refused the sash. She removed it. Twice. She is currently standing on it, which the desk is logging as *forecast: pressure*. Varga, the payout stands, the sash is now decorative, and the ninth tassel is your problem in perpetuity.
So the Guild pays me in credits, the goat pays in standing-on-things, and nobody files the report?

The weather desk settles its obligations in goat credit — exchangeable for one (1) favourable stare in storm season, redeemable at the overlook, no expiry. Collectors pay double for those. Ask me what they taste like.

choices.prompt: The desk asks how to close the incident on Form 22-B.

options.text: "Write: instrument self-decommissioned. Goat remains at large."
"Give me the pen. I'll write 'resolved' and we'll never speak of tassel nine."
